name: nTSWorld::cWorldDBMessageData::Release
notes: Returns the new count, or 0 after writing the class vtable and freeing the block (operator delete). Test checks the return value and, per block, whether it was freed (HeapValidate) on both sides. The vtable write before the free is not observable (the heap overwrites the block's first bytes). Hooked (table src/hook/tables/TopCallersA.cpp), not run in-game. Mutants killed: count off by one; no delete; survivor returns 0.

name: SetWindowEnabled
notes: Takes three cdecl args (window, id, enabled): the child from slot 39 (id), then slot 82 (flag 2) compared with the low byte of enabled, and slot 83 (2, enabled) when they differ. Differentially tested with fake vtables (call order, args, return al): 20,000 cases, mutants killed (compare inverted, wrong arg, wrong slot, return value, id for enabled). Hooked (TS2-Extender also hooks it; native mod DLLs are no longer a compatibility target).

name: cRZMemPtrIterator<unsigned short>::vf3 (Copy)
notes: Allocates 16 bytes (operator new), writes the class vtable, zeroes +4 and copies +8 and +0xc. Test compares the 16-byte copies with random source words (the source's vtable and +4 must not be copied). The null-allocation branch is not reachable in the harness, so it is kept but untested. Hooked (table TopCallersA.cpp), not run in-game. Mutants killed: +4 copied, +0xc from +8.

name: nGZCommandParser::cBlockCommand::vf3
notes: Stores the object (+4) and value (+0xc), then stores the low byte of the object's slot-43 result at +0x3c. Test compares the whole 0x40-byte object and the number of slot-43 calls. Hooked (table TopCallersA.cpp), not run in-game. Mutants killed: value not stored, object not stored, result +1.
